name: wh-mods
description: Windhawk mod suite — AudioSwap, MicSwitch, Net-Toggle, MicroManager, Bt Battery Monitor. C++ Windows internals mods using COM, Win32 hooks, and Raw Input. 20 PRs merged upstream to ramensoftware/windhawk-mods.
tagline: Toggle audio devices, mute mics, kill network — from the system tray, no bloat.

name: Alternify
description: Live software-alternatives directory with 5,000+ alternatives. Dark cyber aesthetic, Cloudflare edge, AdSense + Ezoic monetization.
tagline: Find open-source alternatives to paid software — no fluff, just direct swaps.

name: HellCat
description: High-performance HashCat automation suite for Windows. Streamlines WPA-PMKID/EAPOL password recovery with interactive mode selection and batch orchestration.
tagline: One-command WPA hash cracking on Windows — batch, watch, collect results.

name: TheListener
description: MITM attack automation suite — Bettercap, Nmap, and Scapy. Monitor, fingerprint, and intercept HTTP/HTTPS traffic across the local network.
tagline: See every HTTP/HTTPS request on your network — revealed live.

name: SAP
description: SOC Analyst Professional training platform — interactive assessment for Tier-1 analysts. 300+ questions across 7 security domains, 90-minute exam, zero backend.
tagline: Train Tier-1 SOC analysts: 300 questions, 7 domains, one 90-minute exam.

name: TerminalLife
description: GPU-accelerated evolution simulator — creatures with neural-network brains and genetic algorithms compete, hunt, and survive in your Windows terminal. PyTorch + CUDA.
tagline: Watch autonomous creatures evolve, hunt, and survive in your terminal.

name: Bundler
description: Universal link bundler with metadata fetching — title, image, and price grabbed automatically. Flask-based bundle manager with view and edit.
tagline: Bundle links into shareable pages — titles, previews, prices auto-fetched.
